leftEvidence.title: A Canaanite woman presses against Israel’s mission boundary

points.label: Israel setting and claim
points.left: A woman calls Jesus Son of David and asks mercy, the disciples seek dismissal, and Jesus names the lost sheep of Israel and children’s bread.
points.right: After the rich man departs, Jesus speaks of difficulty, divine possibility, renewal, twelve thrones, twelve tribes, relinquished households, and reversal of first and last.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: her reply about crumbs is followed by praise and healing.

payload.posture: The Canaanite woman presses against an Israel-first mission, while the disciples receive a promise involving Israel’s tribes.

rightEvidence.title: The Twelve are promised judgment over Israel’s tribes

payload.tension: Access through persistent appeal and future tribal judgment place Israel’s boundary and destiny under different pressures.
payload.title: An outsider at the boundary and the future of twelve tribes
